component.name: Capycal
component.summary: Calendar sync that knows how to keep a secret

description.p: Capycal copies events from one calendar into another and leaves out what the other side doesn't need to know. Your colleagues know when you're free, your private appointments stay private.

A tray icon runs your syncs in the background. Settings sets up a new sync in a few clicks, with a live preview of what a copy will look like. Capycal works with any CalDAV server, such as Nextcloud or Radicale, and reads iCal feeds such as Google's secret address. GNOME needs the AppIndicator extension to show the tray icon.
